message:

from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate.ini')
p.write_text('[global]\ndescription=$ncpus\n')
print(p)
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/fio/init.c","function":"__parse_jobs_ini","line":2065,"var":"p","code":"opts[num_opts] = strdup(p);","note":"Reads the attacker-controlled ini line into a heap-allocated option string."},
 {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/fio/init.c","function":"__parse_jobs_ini","line":2075,"var":"opts","code":"ret = fio_options_parse(td, opts, num_opts);","note":"Passes the parsed option array to option processing."},
 {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/fio/options.c","function":"fio_options_parse","line":5195,"var":"opts_copy","code":"opts_copy = dup_and_sub_options(opts, num_opts);","note":"Duplicates each option string and prepares keyword substitution on the copy."},
 {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/fio/options.c","function":"dup_and_sub_options","line":5150,"var":"opts_copy[i]","code":"opts_copy[i] = fio_keyword_replace(opts_copy[i]);","note":"Invokes keyword replacement on the copied option string containing $ncpus."},
 {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/fio/options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5098,"var":"opt","code":"while ((s = strstr(opt, kw->word)) != NULL) {","note":"Finds the $ncpus keyword inside the option value and begins substitution."},
 {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/fio/options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5115,"var":"opt","code":"opt += strlen(kw->word) + olen;","note":"Advances opt past the keyword using the original match offset, which can move it beyond the remaining buffer."},
 {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/fio/options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5119,"var":"opt","code":"if (strlen(opt)) memcpy(new + olen + len, opt, opt - o_org - 1);","note":"Uses the advanced pointer in strlen/memcpy length calculations, causing an out-of-bounds read/write when opt no longer points into the original string."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('trace written')
PY
